title: Japanese Yen edges higher vs bullish USD amid expectations of a more hawkish BoJ
summary: The USD/JPY pair edges lower during the Asian session on Thursday, snapping a three-day winning streak and eroding a part of the previous day's gains to a nearly two-week high.

title: US President Donald Trump says he told Fed Chair to 'do what you want' ahead of rate hike
summary: US President Donald Trump said that he counseled Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh to vote for an interest rate hike because other Fed policymakers were expected to vote that way anyway, the Washington post reported on Wednesday.

title: Euro weakens to near 1.1450 as Fed raises rate for first time in three years
summary: The EUR/USD pair declines to around 1.1460 during Asian trading hours on Thursday. The Euro (EUR) weakens against the US Dollar (USD) following an interest rate hike from the US Federal Reserve (Fed). The US Initial Jobless Claims data will be released later on Thursday.

title: Reports: US, Houthis make secret deal over Yemen war
summary: Yemen’s Houthis have agreed to allow US shipping unfettered Red Sea access if Washington refrains from military action.

title: UK’s Burnham, Canada’s Carney discuss AI risks, defence cooperation
summary: UK and Canada explore AI risks, defence cooperation and joint initiatives during a bilateral meeting in Liverpool.
